//: P10-M5-T01 sample config. The shipped DEFAULT is OFF and non-phoning:
//public_key: Hex-encoded Ed25519 public key that signs every manifest. See workstreams/security/keys/oep-update-signing.pub (P11-T04 committed release key).
//current_version: Optional; defaults to the crate build version when null.
//timeout_ms: Remote fetch timeout for a url: source (default 3000).
//channel_note: UPDATE-CHANNEL (decision #20): this SAME shape is what the settings toggle writes and reads, so update-check.sample.json stays truthful about the persisted format. Three states are distinguishable at runtime: On (enabled=true + a source), OffByUser (this file PRESENT with enabled=false, written by the toggle), OffNeverConfigured (no settings file exists and the build has no public default). A public build resolves the never-configured state to ON with its baked default remote source; private/air-gapped builds stay OFF here. Persisted settings path: OEP_UPDATE_SETTINGS, else $XDG_CONFIG_HOME (or $HOME/.config)/isolith/update-check.json.
//offer_note: When a check returns Unreachable or Untrusted, the program OFFERS ONCE to turn update checking off; the answer persists in update-offers.json (or OEP_UPDATE_OFFERS) and never repeats for that condition.
//feed_note: The signed update.bundle.json a release cut publishes to its artifact store (dist/<version>/) is the SAME file listed in docs-site/downloads.json and carried inside air-gap bundles, so the site, the in-program check and an air-gapped install read identical signed bytes.
